briefing.headline: No solid material in PSI was tested above 22.2 % O₂ — the spacesuit runs at 100 %.

sentences.text: No PSI test-level data exists for the Solid phase in this region, so this briefing is extrapolation.
The spacesuit O₂ partial pressure is 4.3 psi, which is 40% above Earth's 3.07 psi.
The highest measured O₂ in solid tests is 22.2 %, leaving a gap of 77.8 points from the query.
Solid-material tests above 25 % measured O₂ are zero, limiting the ability to assess PMMA behavior at high concentrations.
Material contrasts at 22.1 % O₂ show PMMA burned, while silicone self-extinguished, indicating material-specific outcomes in similar atmospheres.
SAFFIRE tests at 18-25 % O₂ show a 63.6% burn rate, though these results cannot be generalized to 100 % O₂ environments.

gaps: No solid-phase test data exists for O₂ concentrations above 22.2 %.

next_tests.why: Evaluate PMMA combustion behavior at the specific spacesuit O₂ and pressure conditions.
Compare silicone performance against PMMA at the query O₂ and pressure.

confidence.reason: The query O₂ concentration of 100 % is significantly outside the range of all 263 available solid-phase tests.
